incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Elevated p95 latency observed for eu-prod inference cluster (eu1). Incident ID INC-2026-042. Paging on-call.

sara.m: paging in — I'm oncall, looking.

liam.k: I got the page, joining. Any initial metrics?

sara.m: p95 jump from ~120ms -> 700ms-1.2s across gen endpoints, embeddings mostly stable. Throughput down ~15% in eu1. 502 spikes minimal. Request rate normal.

eva: seeing tail latency correlate with controller GC spikes and some nvlink errors on node gpu-12. Autoscaler attempted to scale but hit quota on a couple zones.

mike: capacity constrained for batch spoolers; some jobs stuck in ready queue. Logs show repeated `kernel launch failed: NVLINK_TIMEOUT` on ~10% of pods.

sara.m: runbook step1: disable batching on affected pool temporarily. @liam.k can you flip eu1-pool to low-latency mode?

liam.k: doing it now. curl command:

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/pools/eu1-pool/config" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"batch_policy":"low-latency","max_batch_size":1}'
```

liam.k: applied, waiting 30s to observe.

support-bot: statuspage draft ready: "We are investigating elevated latency in the EU region causing slower responses for some API requests. Mitigations are being applied. No data loss reported. Further updates in 15 minutes." Want me to post?

product-ops: yes please post and cc the affected customers list. Mark impact as High latency.

sara.m: also enabling burst capacity — @ops_lead please approve increasing eu1 reserved nodes from 20 -> 30 for now.

ops_lead: approved, triggering scale. ETA ~90s.

eva: draining pods showing nvlink errors, restarting gpu-12 on the affected rack now.

mike: rolling a driver bump to the affected nodes, one at a time. Patch will be staged to avoid full pool churn.

sara.m: handoff plan: I'll act as incident lead. @liam.k you'll be first responder after my 15m check-in.

liam.k: ack. I'll monitor latency dashboards and logs. Also preparing to bias traffic to us-west as a fallback for heavy tenants.

sara.m: draft customer notification for targeted tenants:

```
Hi <Customer>,

We're investigating elevated API latency for the EU region. We've applied temporary mitigations including low-latency batching and capacity increases. No data loss is expected. We'll provide an update when 95th percentile latency returns to baseline. Estimated ETA 15-30 minutes.

— Redwood Incident Response
```

support-bot: Posted status page update (INC-2026-042) and queued targeted customer notifications.

sara.m: metrics update: 2 minutes after batch change p95 dropped ~900ms -> ~320ms. Throughput recovering to ~97% of baseline. Error rate unchanged.

eva: driver patch applied to gpu-12, restarted. NVLINK errors on that node dropped to near-zero.

mike: continuing driver roll across remaining affected nodes over next ~10 minutes. No need for full redeploy.

liam.k: routing change: temporarily biasing traffic to us-west for top tenants. command: 

```
redwood route set --region-preference eu1=90,us-west=10 --filter "tenant in (t1,t2,t3,t4,t5)"
```

liam.k: applied for the top 5 tenants; monitoring impact.

product-ops: prepare follow-up status with RCA timeline and mitigation guidance for customers (e.g., reduce batch size client-side, use region failover).

sara.m: agreed. Notes to capture: timeline, mitigations, affected nodes & driver versions, follow-ups (increase autoscaler quotas, nvlink diagnostics, runbook update for driver auto-rollback).

ops_lead: current estimate for full stable recovery after driver roll and autoscaler stabilization: 20-30 minutes. Marking impact as "degraded latency (partial)".

support-bot: customer notifications delivered to 12 tenants. No immediate escalations.

liam.k: 10m check: p95 ~190ms, throughput ~99% baseline. Keeping routing bias for 10 more minutes then revert.

sara.m: thanks team. Starting post-incident template. Please drop any logs/timestamps/notes into the incident doc:
- timestamps of key actions
- exact commands used
- nodes affected and driver versions
- cost impact (we toggled batching -> low-latency; estimated +4% cost this hour)

eva: adding kernel traces and nvlink metrics to the incident doc now.

mike: note that we saw autoscaler fail to request extra capacity due to quota; follow-up to request quota bump in eu region.

sara.m: handing off active monitoring to @liam.k for the next 2 hours. I'm available for customer comms. Incident remains active. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident status changed: Mitigation applied — Partial recovery observed. Incident assigned to liam.k. Last update 2184012400."
